name: mcp-chipradar
description: Full-stack AI compute intelligence for agents: live OpenRouter provider scorecards (TTFT, tok/s, uptime) + cloud-vs-local break-even against vendor-verified SBC/mini-PC pricing, deal scores, and restock alerts — one MCP server to pick the best cloud route now or price owning the hardware.

public_demo_mode.description: Runs keyless as a preview of the Free tier: returns public demo data from https://chipradar.io/api/products/current plus registration instructions.

api_tiers.description: Four usage tiers, one key unlocking both REST and MCP: $0/100/mo (Sandbox, keyless preview), $12/5k/mo (Indie, live provider scorecard), $49/50k/mo (Pro, restock + provider-degradation webhooks), $199/250k+/mo (Enterprise, SLA scorecards + on-request probing).
